title: Sewing Actions
summary: Students connect familiar tools and fabrics to sewing actions, read and hear a simple sewing sequence, practice imperative process language, and produce a short app-ready process card.
essential_question: How can I explain a simple sewing process clearly in English?
professional_context: Week 8 connects English to introductory sewing workflow, handling fabric safely, following basic studio instructions, and describing a simple hem or stitch sample. Students begin using process language that will support later patternmaking, prototyping, and garment-construction discussion.
language_focus: sewing verbs such as cut, fold, pin, sew, press, measure, mark, and check
tool-action phrases such as Use scissors to cut the fabric
step-order language such as first, then, next, after that, and finally
location phrases such as along the line and at the hem
quality-check language such as straight, even, and check the stitches
grammar_focus: first / then / next / after that / finally
teacher_preparation: Preview the Week 8 opener board, the sewing-actions board, the tools-and-actions board, the hem reading board, and the reusable process gallery before class.
Prepare visible sentence frames for Cut the fabric, Fold the edge, Use ___ to ___, First ..., Then ..., Next ..., After that ..., and Finally ....
Keep the writing task line-based and scaffolded. Do not turn the Simple Sewing Process Card into a paragraph or word-count assignment.
Review likely Week 8 correction targets such as missing articles, missing to in tool phrases, punctuation after sequence words, and along the line versus on the line.
Keep the Week 8 listening audio or teacher read-aloud fallback aligned exactly to the same image A to E gallery used in listening, writing, and speaking.
Decide whether students will use projected process boards, printed cards, or simple physical sewing tools alongside the future app-style visuals in the teacher session.
student_deliverables: Completion of the Week 8 opener selections.
Completion of the main sewing-actions matching set.
Completion of tool-action fill-blank phrase practice.
Reading-comprehension responses about a simple hem process.
Listening-comprehension responses about one simple sewing sequence.
Completion of sequence-word and imperative phrase practice.
A scaffolded Simple Sewing Process Card with 6 required sentence-frame lines and 1 optional challenge sentence.
Two corrected Week 8 process sentences saved after review.
A short teacher-observed oral explanation of one simple sewing process.
